import brackets.core as bc
# Test cases
tests = [
    ("", True),
    ("()", True),
    ("[]", True),
    ("{}", True),
    ("()[]{}", True),
    ("([{}])", True),
    ("(a[b]{c})", True),
    ("f(x[0], y[1])", True),
    ("(", False),
    (")", False),
    ("([)]", False),
    ("(?]", False),  # Actually '(]' from spec
    ("{[", False),
    ("())", False),
]
for s, expected in tests:
    res = bc.is_balanced(s)
    if res != expected:
        print(f"FAIL: is_balanced({repr(s)}) = {res}, expected {expected}")
        raise AssertionError("Test failed")
print("All bracket tests passed")
# Test non-string input
for bad in [123, None, [], {}]:
    try:
        bc.is_balanced(bad)
        print(f"FAIL: Expected TypeError for {bad}")
        raise AssertionError("TypeError not raised")
    except TypeError:
        pass
print("All TypeError tests passed")

import brackets.core as bc
# Test cases from acceptance criteria
tests = [
    ("", True),
    ("()", True),
    ("[]", True),
    ("{}", True),
    ("()[]{}", True),
    ("([{}])", True),
    ("(a[b]{c})", True),
    ("f(x[0], y[1])", True),
    ("(", False),
    (")", False),
    ("([)]", False),
    ("(?]", False),  # This is actually '(]' from spec; keep as is
    ("{[", False),
    ("())", False),
]
for s, expected in tests:
    res = bc.is_balanced(s)
    if res != expected:
        raise AssertionError(f"FAIL: is_balanced({repr(s)}) = {res}, expected {expected}")
print("All bracket tests passed")
# Non-bracket characters ignored
assert bc.is_balanced("a(b)c[d]e{f}g") == True
assert bc.is_balanced("a(b]c") == False
print("Ignoring non-brackets works")
# TypeError
for bad in [123, None, [], {}, 3.14]:
    try:
        bc.is_balanced(bad)
        raise AssertionError(f"Expected TypeError for {bad}")
    except TypeError:
        pass
print("All TypeError tests passed")
print("All tests passed.")",
